primary_endpoint: Not specified in the abstract; NAFLD was assessed by liver biopsy.
efficacy_outcome: No statistically significant between-group changes in NAFLD. Compared with HCLF, LCHF improved HbA1c more (difference in change −6.1 mmol/mol; 95% CI −9.2 to −3.0) and reduced weight more (−3.8 kg; 95% CI −6.2 to −1.4); changes were not sustained at 9 months.
